name: Hesitates
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: an avoidant soldier starts to answer the commander and stops.

name: Hesitates after a quarrel
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: after a quarrel she starts to answer and stops, whatever her attachment.

name: Deletes a message
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: after a quarrel she sends something and takes it back before the commander can read it.

name: Double text
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: when she wants the commander's company her message comes as several short ones.

name: Late at night
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a message she starts herself late in the day, when she wants the commander's company, is stamped LATE.

name: Voice message
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: someone close sometimes sends a voice message instead of text; the words show when the commander plays it.

name: Curt, resentful
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a resentful soldier answers in a word or two.

name: Curt after a cold day
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: when her warmth for the commander has dropped today she answers in a word or two.
